digest.component_or_area: CONTRIBUTING documentation and code review process
propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked WIP to enforce holds that are invisible in ticket comments and session logs.
Documentation must surface the WIP hold mechanism in CONTRIBUTING.md §2d (authoritative source), passing-code-review.md guide, and AGENTS.md so all contributors encounter it.
Both push-time (%wip syntax) and post-push (REST endpoint) forms of marking WIP must be documented alongside unmark paths (%ready and /ready).
The packaged code-review guide must be verified reachable through the registry mapping (rebar explain review), not by file path alone.
Test coverage must confirm the rule is present on all three surfaces and fail when removed from the authoritative source.
